findings.heading: 8. 商品横断のP&L契約
findings.title: Separate exact calendar roll from new curve representation
findings.risk: Exact old-curve ratio roll generally cannot be represented on newly resolved fixed-tenor knots. Vf can differ from recalibrated price at q_roll even with zero quote move. Assigning the entire V1-Vf to market Taylor then confounds representation change with quote/fixing risk.
findings.minimal_fix: Preserve shifted absolute old knots with exact roll support or explicitly add regrid/rebootstrap value term. Market Taylor must center on the resulting representable calibrated state and its fixing-conditioned quotes; include a zero-move counterexample.

findings.heading: 5. 独立参照と主要実験
findings.title: IM reduction fixture must preserve legal netting boundary
findings.risk: Bundle(c) puts hedge in a separate non-nettable set yet proposes IM reduction. With existing terms/threshold fixed, existing set IM is unchanged and new hedge set posted IM is nonnegative; common funding/capital pooling does not permit cross-set IM risk offsets.
findings.primary_source: MGN20.14; same legal boundary already stated by draft sections1/3/4
findings.minimal_fix: Use a same-set different-maturity hedge for IM-benefit/capital-residual bundle and keep separate-set no-IM-offset as a validation comparator. Recompute each set and bank capital/funding aggregates independently.
